install.notes: pyproject.toml:10 requires Python >=3.9,<3.12 and :26-32 pins gymnasium 0.29.1, mani_skill 3.0.0b15, numpy 1.23.5 and torch 2.2.1. The gate and the fake backend need none of them: fake.py is pure Python, and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package. Install it only to serve the real environment (the unlisted sim backend), which was not run.
